csv_project_name: Design Service for Broad Causeway Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Bay Harbor Islands ( Town ) is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified, experienced, and properly licensed professional engineering consulting firms to provide comprehensive design and support services for the replacement of the Sheppard Broad Causeway as part of the Town s Bridge Replacement Program: The selected Consultant shall furnish all expertise, personnel, and resources necessary to perform professional services for the planning, design, permitting, and bidding phases of both bridge replacement projects, in accordance with all applicable Federal, State, and Local regulations. Consultant(s) must be registered and licensed to practice engineering in the State of Florida, and must demonstrate substantial experience in major bridge design and construction projects of similar scope and complexity.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
